CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

2. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 25
   C. 31
   D. 27

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

6. Solve for x: x + 6 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 14
   C. 8
   D. 9

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

9. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 24.5

10. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 0

   A. 5

   D. 13

12. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16

   D. 65

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

14. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 30
   C. 23
   D. 120

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

17. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

18. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

19. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

20. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23

   C. 29
   D. 23.7

21. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7

   A. 10
   B. 4

23. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 88
   C. 22
   D. 38

25. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

26. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49

   C. 7

27. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82

   C. 18

28. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   D. 27.6

29. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

30. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 3
